verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's own end-to-end encrypted cloud sync puts all codes on every device signed into the account, so a new phone gets every token without re-enrolling. Offline-mode users have a documented fallback: an encrypted export that can be imported without signing in. Missing for 10: no documented guided new-phone migration flow, no hands-on or independent corroboration of a phone-to-phone transfer, and offline users must export and import manually rather than in one step.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Auth has an app for every platform. Mobile, desktop and web. Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
Auth provides end-to-end encrypted cloud backups so you don't have to worry about losing your tokens.
exporting the encrypted backup is another good way to reduce the risk (you can easily import the encrypted backup without signing in)
